dataQualityNotes: Secure configuration guidance is not applicable because Canopy does not currently have end-agency users. A next Ongoing Certification Report date is not yet known because Canopy is awaiting Agency Authorization.
Canopy is Agency Authorization in Process and does not have a certification date. The certifiedServices.dateAvailable value is the SSP's fully operational date, 2025-12-15, not a certification date.
The schema requires assessor.id while defining assessorID as the named property. This package includes both properties with the same FedRAMP Marketplace assessor ID.
Ripcord confirmed Canopy is a multi-tenant, Government-Only offering.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Canopy is Ripcord's multi-tenant, Government-Only Software-as-a-Service offering for Federal Government Agencies that require Digitization-as-a-Service capabilities. It is a document intelligence platform that uses secure orchestration and workflow processing, robotics, OCR/ICR and image analysis, Google Gemini large language models, custom machine-learning models, business rules, and agent-in-the-loop quality assurance to digitize, classify, extract, validate, and deliver data from structured and unstructured documents. Canopy is deployed as a managed application tenant on stackArmor's The Armory General Support System.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Direct public shared-file download endpoint for the machine-readable Canopy FedRAMP Certification Overview Package JSON.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: The URL is publicly available without authentication, approval workflows, or access justification and resolves to the Canopy Certification Overview Package JSON.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Ripcord's multi-tenant, Government-Only SaaS document intelligence and Digitization-as-a-Service offering for Federal Government Agencies. Canopy processes structured and unstructured documents through secure orchestration, document digitization, OCR/ICR and image analysis, AI-supported extraction, validation, and quality-assurance workflows. Canopy is Agency Authorization in Process.

certified.useCase: Google Services provides the High-impact FedRAMP-authorized IaaS/PaaS foundation and underlying infrastructure used by Canopy.

Okta IDaaS Government High Cloud provides Universal Directory, API integration, the Sign-In Widget, logging, administration, adaptive multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and Okta Verify for privileged infrastructure users.
GovSlack provides messaging services for operational notifications and alerts used by privileged infrastructure users.
The Armory General Support System provides the FedRAMP Certified Rev5 Agency Class D (High) foundation, managed application-tenant environment, and underlying security services used by Canopy.

nonCertified.name: Ripcord on-premise digitization facility
nonCertified.useCase: The facility provides secure on-premise scanning stations, network links, and interfaces to IRS repositories. It connects to Canopy through a site-to-site Fortinet VPN and is authorized under the IRS 4812 High baseline.
